about: The answers of audit-pins-driver.sh judge and together, after the list, baseline and test-pin steps that lead to them, over real git repositories. Generated from the script and never edited by hand. Each row holds its recipe. The setup copies spec/fixtures/<fixture> to $ROOT/repo, commits it, runs `pre` there, and adds the detached worktree $ROOT/work/audit. The work directory is $ROOT/work. `npm`, `pnpm` and `yarn` on PATH are the stand-in package manager `stand_in_pm`, which counts each install in $PM_DIR/install.n and sources $PM_DIR/install.sh. `gh` on PATH is `stand_in_gh`. It serves $GH_DIR/advisories.json, which holds the `advisories` pages of the step or else of the row, or it fails with the text of $GH_DIR/fail, which holds `gh_fail` of the step. The advisory lookup is the real check-advisories.sh, and the adapter is the real node.sh. Before each step, install.sh holds `install` (or nothing) and install.status holds `install_status` (or 0), and `edit` runs in the worktree. Each step runs the script with `args`; `list` also gets `--adapter $PLUGIN/scripts/ecosystems/node.sh`. After the last step, `state` is the state file, `porcelain` is git status --porcelain in the worktree, `seen` holds the files that install.sh copied, `cache` holds each file of $ROOT/work/advisories as JSON, and `installs` is the install count. $ROOT is the physical row root and $PLUGIN is plugins/gh-security. The run had a neutral HOME and TMPDIR.
setup:
mkdir -p "$REPO" "$PM_DIR" "$GH_DIR"
cp -R "$FIXTURE/." "$REPO/"
g -C "$REPO" init -q -b main
commit_all fixture
(cd "$REPO" && eval "$PRE")
g -C "$REPO" worktree add -q --detach "$WT" HEAD
